text: On the authority of Ubadah ibn al-Samit, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, he said: Whoever becomes disgraced at night and says: There is no god but God alone, with no partner, to Him belongs dominion and to Him is praise, and He is capable of all things. Praise be to God, and Glory be to God, and God is great, and there is no power nor strength except in God. Then he says: O God, forgive me, or if he supplicates, his prayer will be answered. If he performs ablution and prays, his prayer will be accepted.
